notes.title: Game Officially Released
notes.content:
The final update consists of adding the game and full DLC.

### Campaign Additions

- You can turn the flashlight off and on to save battery power.
- The human kills you on the spot for having a knife, but he doesn't see you from afar with the flashlight turned off.
- The robot only deals one damage, sees in the dark and, suddenly, can appear behind you.
- There were no changes to the monstrous; It's still as difficult.
- The final boss now launches a continuous beam.

### DLC Additions

- Cutscenes in all stages.
- New conquests.

### Additions in General

- Major bug fix.
